content: Head of Product reads across the paper. 'Week 1: start everything that takes time to come back. Germination trays, pilot, bloom-or-not, survey review, legal pack drafted. Week 2: build the artefacts. Lid card proof, spec card, remedy wording into professional review, waitlist live with the A/Bs. Week 3: decide. Each line has an owner, a rough cost and a test, and Research's sheet is pinned beside it.'
